text: I've been using Baan Luck Fun in Maenam for approx. 8 years. Mainly for teeth cleaning and occasional general dentistry, if needed. Dr. Noi has delicate hands, so there's rarely any pain. Dr. Noi has the most skilled and gentle hands ever.  She had to pull three of my teeth in one sitting, and I felt nearly nothing (including the anesthesia needles going in).
